title: Geometry-inconsistent continuation examples
selection_rule: For each method in the frozen display order, scan frozen cases in Scan A pair 1, Scan A pair 2, Scan B pair 1, Scan B pair 2 order and select the first frame/branch row that is an accepted Gaussian fit outside the 18 px branch-consistency gate.
claim_limits: The examples are operational evidence of geometry-inconsistent continuation, not externally proven identity switches.
The deterministic first-record selection is explanatory and does not support tracker ranking.
Frozen visibility status, expected branch coordinate, native proposal and common Gaussian center remain distinct.
